{"action_id":"rewrite_mux","rationale":"The mux inputs have a 0.90 ns external arrival penalty, making this region the preferred timing target. Explicit one-hot decoding incorporates selectors 10–15 directly into select_a and avoids a separate default-selection path. This localized rewrite is expected to improve maximum arrival with limited area impact while leaving the independently mapped priority block unchanged. It preserves all two-state mux outputs, including the default, and retains the original encoder invalid-input behavior. Exact timing improvement and compliance with the 2719.608320 um^2 limit cannot be certified without mapped results."}
